name: Tokenizer probe links Arena's anonymous Kalmia model to Qwen's tokenizer
title: Tokenizer probe links Arena's anonymous Kalmia model to Qwen's tokenizer
summary: The same chat-only tokenizer test used for Kibitz shows Kalmia garbling 6 of 8 Qwen-specific tokens and none of 40 from other labs, matching Qwen 3.7 and 3.8, which suggests an unreleased Alibaba model, though other labs also reuse Qwen's tokenizer.
